The TLA+ model of the gate (`.agents/skills/verify-gate/model/`) describes how one holder at a time writes the records of a Game. A holder is a Job or an Autoplay run. This sequence diagram shows one order of its steps, which TLC took one by one. Every invariant of the model held in each state. The order shows this rule: After a stop, no write of the stopped Job lands. TLC checked this rule in each state of the order.

```mermaid
---
title: "A stop during the narrator call"
---
sequenceDiagram
  participant You as Player
  participant G as GameWriter
  participant J1 as Job 1
  participant L as LLM
  You->>G: send an Action
  Note over G: Job 1 holds Game 1
  J1->>G: save the Input, set the step
  J1->>L: narrator call
  You->>G: press Stop
  Note over G: the holder (Job 1) goes, and its work is cut off. The Game shows no failure line and no Options failure
  L-->>J1: the text
  J1-xG: save the text: refused, the holder is not Job 1
  Note over J1: Job 1 ends and writes nothing more
```
